scope: Recovery knowledge closure from exact authority/source artifacts; no product promotion and no interactive browser claim.

checks.evidence: Lineage registers only pagekit-v26/pagekit-v37; Psico is a catalog consumer.

checks.check: Catalog liveness not treated as product authority
checks.evidence: Matrix records live entries as discovery/routing evidence only.
eraserDown is set on pointerdown, checked on pointermove, cleared on pointerup/cancel/leave.
eraserDown has the same press/move/release gating around eraseAt.
pointerMove returns unless state.pressed/pointerId match before eraseAt.
curve draft accumulates points and auto-finishes when the third point is reached.
curve3 pushes the curve when curvePoints.length === 3.
boardSessions, activeBoardId, renderBoardTabs and per-board ink/objects/undo are implemented.
typed undo actions include transformObject, deleteObject, pasteObject, eraseStroke, addStroke and clearSurface.
undoActive pops activeInk only; no reversible erase action evidenced.
pkUndoBtn pops activeSurface().strokes; eraseAt directly splices strokes.
Generic Pointer Events exist but no pressure or stylus-button implementation was evidenced.
No application requestFullscreen implementation evidenced; Psico allowFullscreen is iframe-local.
Source explicitly separates unselected-object laser drag from selected-object edit interaction.
V37 board sessions/objects and Psico sheet canvases are recorded as distinct models.
R07 writes are coordination/recovery only; Current/Catalog/Lineage/source pages remain read-only.
This lane closes recovery knowledge, not a product implementation candidate. No browser runtime pass is claimed.

future_integration_falsifiers: Run representative mouse, touch and stylus input against whichever product candidate adopts recovered mechanics.
Verify eraser never deletes without an active press, including pointerleave and pointercancel transitions.
For V37-derived object/erase behavior, verify undo restores erased strokes and object transforms without leaking state across boards.
Verify laser drag over an unselected object does not move/resize/select it, while an explicitly selected object remains editable through its intended handles/path.
Verify board/session or sheet state remains isolated when switching tabs and resizing/orienting the viewport.
Add pressure and pen-button tests only if a future implementation actually consumes those signals.
Add application fullscreen tests only if a product owner introduces a true Fullscreen API implementation.
runtime_boundary: Static authority/source inspection is sufficient to close the recovery lane because no product bytes or authority pointers are promoted. It is not sufficient to claim a new product candidate is browser-validated, Human Accepted or Served.
